key_notes: Key 1 (t=0.6s): Initial archival pose of cruise-ship; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=1.73s): Mid-sequence articulation of cruise-ship; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=2.96s): Peak dynamic extension of cruise-ship over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=4.2s): Follow-through and settle of cruise-ship with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of cruise-ship (0.6s..4.2s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
